days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: I'd like to open at 114 P for delivery on day 0.
I can do 163 P with delivery in 10 days. Every round costs us both, so let's close.
Your offer is too high. I'll come down to 112 P if you meet me at day 10.
I can come down to 160 P with delivery on day 10. That's a fair deal for both of us.
I can do 127 P, delivery on day 10.
Meeting you closer: 131 P with delivery in 10 days.
